phase: phase 5 (2026-10-26) — per-word decisions for the settled transcript
doctrine: WORD DECISION CONTAINER (owner, 2026-10-24): every word carries a recorded decision — a treatment, or a deliberate as-is — grounded in tempo, effect, and story function. A word with no record is randomness.
source: Decided fresh in this branch against the settled transcript (phase 3). Timings (start/end) and treatments are the renderer's data, extracted from the first draft's scene PLAN as evidence and re-audited word by word here: each word's grounds are computed from its own measured duration against its line's median and its phrase role; the audit affirmed every treatment (the scene embodies them — DR-WORD-1/2/3) and changed none. Where a future re-decision lands differently, it will say so in that word's record.
